meta.title: Warsaw FPV Drone Building Workshops | DroneAid Collective
meta.description: Warsaw-based non-profit team building FPV drones for humanitarian operations in Ukraine. Join our workshops, become a mentor or donate drone components. 100% to hardware.

hero_sub: We gather in Warsaw to build FPV drones from scratch by teaching electronics, soldering and flight systems. Every drone we assemble is donated to humanitarian operations in Ukraine
mission_card_one_txt: 100% of donated funds go directly to purchasing motors, frames, flight controllers, batteries and cameras.
mission_card_two_txt: No experience needed. Participants learn electronics fundamentals, safe soldering technique and full drone assembly from mentor engineers.
mission_card_three_txt: Completed and tested drones are handed to partner humanitarian organizations for logistics, mine detection and evacuation support missions.
support_txt: Donate a single component or fund an entire drone. Every contribution goes straight to the next workshop build batch
tools_txt:
Irons, flux, wire strippers, multimeters.
The workshop essentials shared across every build.
frame_txt: The structural backbone. Lightweight carbon fibre frames that survive hard landings in field conditions.
motors_txt: Brushless motors and propellers — the propulsion system that determines speed, lift and efficiency of every build.
camera_txt: FPV cameras and video transmitters. The eyes of the mission — enabling real-time operator awareness from the air.
battery_txt: LiPo battery packs with the energy density and discharge rate needed for stable, long-duration flight operations.
controller_txt: The brain — a circuit board running Betaflight, processing sensor data and stabilization at thousands of loops per second.
why_txt1: Drones have become critical infrastructure in Ukraine — used for medical supply delivery, situational awareness and mine-clearance operations across vast areas of damaged terrain.
why_txt2: Warsaw sits 400 km from the Ukrainian border. Building here means shorter supply chains, community ties that understand the stakes and a technical base in the heart of Europe. DroneAid Warsaw is not just a workshop — it's a node in a network of solidarity.
why_txt3: Every participant who learns to solder a joint or configure a flight controller becomes part of that network. The skills stay and the drones do their mission.

join_workshop_txt: No prior experience required. Attend a workshop, learn how to solder, understand the technical structure and leave having assembled a real FPV drone. Register via the link below.
join_mentor_txt: Electronics, soldering or you believe your other experience could help the project? Join the mentor team — guide participants, perform final quality checks on completed builds and help develop the project.
join_donate_txt: Fund one component, tools or an entire drone. Full drone donors receive priority workshop access. Each cent goes directly to hardware — zero overhead.
donate_txt1: Funding a whole drone is one workshop spot, one chance to use your hands to secure your future. After assembly, our team takes care of all the logistics needed to deliver the drone to the frontline.
donate_txt2: Your contribution goes 100% to hardware. No admin fees, no overhead.
donate_motor: Frame + motors → drone can fly autonomously for 30 min
donate_camera: FPV camera → operator can navigate trajectory safely
donate_full: Full drone → delivered to a frontline humanitarian unit within 3 weeks
full_drone_txt: Fund an entire build + get workshop spot
